name: Endless Cultivation [CONTENT UPDATE]
desc:
⚡ Endless Cultivation | Beta ⚡
  Inspired by Manhwa & Manhua — forge your legend!

  💪 Cultivation — Meditate (B) to refine Qi & break into new realms of power.
  🧪 Alchemy — Harvest rare herbs, craft pills & gain incredible buffs.
  ⚒️ Mining & Runes — Mine ore & roll Runes to supercharge your Qi.
  ⚔️ Combat — Slay mobs, farm Spirit Stones & claim powerful gear.
  📜 Quests — Take on unique quests & earn exclusive rewards!

  💻 Controls:
  M1: Attack | F: Block | Q: Dash | T: Qi Vision | H: Fly | B: Cultivate | M: Menu | Z/X/C/V: Skills | CTRL/ALT: Shiftlock

  Tags: Cultivation, Manhwa, Manhua, Murim, Wuxia, Xianxia, Reborn, Boss, Alchemy, Quests
